arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE t.amount_usd_cents > 100000 AND c.card_type = 'Debit'
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions over $1,000 made with debit cards, excluding prepaid debit cards.
assumptions: 'debit' was matched to the stored value 'Debit' (case-sensitive), which excludes 'Debit (Prepaid)' cards as requested.
"Over 1000 dollars" means strictly more than $1,000, i.e. amount_usd_cents > 100000.
All transactions count, whether or not they have a fraud label.
